classification.STAY_OUT: SUPPORTED_NOW (may be inert vs baseline; inert is reported, not hidden)
classification.TWO_STOP_PLAN: REQUIRES_NEW_MODELING (plan horizon beyond single decision; V3.7)
classification.UNDERCUT_OVERCRT_LABELS: NOT_DEFENSIBLE as action primitives (emergent narrative labels, not interventions)

action_policy.compound_semantics: SAMPLED follows frozen simulator draw; explicit compound changes only stint sampling and future transitions; NO direct compound pace delta (frozen limitation)
action_policy.default_policy: neutral action-space coverage, NOT historical performance
action_policy.scope: single driver, single decision at T, then frozen stochastic mechanics resume

OPTION_2_THIN_PAIRED_LAYER_AROUND_FROZEN.future_v37_compat: HIGH (V3.7 counterfactuals compose on same seam)
OPTION_2_THIN_PAIRED_LAYER_AROUND_FROZEN.scientific_safety: HIGH (frozen engines untouched; pairing at arm level)

architecture.selected_rationale: Phase 7 already implements paired CRN comparison, uncertainty, objectives, eligibility, API, and frontend against the frozen Phase-6 engine. Strategy 2.0's defensible delta is rebasing the intervention seam onto frozen MC2-E semantics plus a widened paired outcome vector. A thin layer reuses all validated substrates with lowest regression risk.

baseline_semantics.adopted_baseline: SIMULATED_NO_INTERVENTION_REFERENCE (frozen stochastic pit mechanics from the same factual state at T; every candidate delta is measured against it)
baseline_semantics.adopted_baseline_note: The Phase 7 baseline is NOT the observed historical future and NOT a claim about what the team should have done. It is the simulator's ordinary-mechanics reference arm.
rejected_as_baseline: ACTUAL_HISTORICAL_ACTION (post-T knowledge; forbidden as decision-time input)
CURRENT_OBSERVED_CONTINUATION where 'observed' smuggles post-T pit events

terminology.decision_time_available_baseline: SIMULATED_NO_INTERVENTION_REFERENCE, computable from causal RaceState(T) alone
terminology.historical_observed_future: post-hoc analysis object; permitted ONLY in V3.6D case-study plausibility review, never as a decision-time input or correctness label

comparison_unit.note: comparison_identity binds state identity + parameter identity + config + master seed + candidate set (Phase 7 precedent); V3.6B freezes exact field list

crn_semantics.applies_to: all admitted actions vs the shared baseline arm
crn_semantics.pairing_unit: complete valid pairs only; partial pairs counted in diagnostics, never imputed
crn_semantics.principle: Same starting RaceState(T), same simulation count, same seed family, same per-(seed,index) RNG stream identity; ONLY the strategy intervention differs. Shares stream identities, NOT trajectories: event ordering may legitimately diverge after the intervention (frozen CRN_ADOPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS).
shared: per-domain pit timing/compound/loss streams up to the intervention point
crn_semantics.structural_divergence_rule: Do NOT force identical draws where the intervention changes the stochastic structure (e.g. an extra pit stop consumes additional loss/compound draws). Forced pits reuse the frozen draw order compound->loss->stint target.

eligibility_policy.base: frozen MC2/Phase-6 eligibility taxonomy (SIMULATION_CAPABLE vs TERMINAL_STATE, UNSUPPORTED_TRACK_STATE, WET_CONDITIONS, MISSING_TYRE_STATE, STALE_ROSTER_OBSERVATION, missing metadata/params, TEMPORAL_POLICY, RETIRED_DRIVER_PRESENT, INVALID_INPUT, RECONSTRUCTION_FAILURE, OTHER)
eligibility_policy.reason_codes: explicit machine-readable unsupported_reason; invalid candidates get evaluated=false + static reason; never a partial table

evaluation_plan_v36d.forbidden_label: Did the team historically choose the same action? (must NOT be used as correctness)
questions: CRN variance reduction (paired SE vs unpaired SE ratio; S3 precedent median ~0.92)
monotonic/sanity scenarios (e.g. huge lead + PIT_NOW rarely improves win prob)

forbidden: future finishing position / status after T
future safety car / weather evolution after T

risk_table.adapter_inputs: SAFE_AT_T (factual-only, null-preserving; never reads future D9/labels/results/model)
risk_table.engine_parameters: SAFE_AT_T (frozen through-2024 parameter artifact; 2025 excluded from estimation)
risk_table.historical_action_after_T: POST_T_FORBIDDEN (never a decision-time input; V3.6D case-study context only)
risk_table.race_results_table: LABEL_ONLY (evaluation attribution only, never a decision input)
risk_table.replay_timeline_position: SAFE_AT_T (exact anchor; scrubber is exact, no interpolation)
risk_table.status_corpus_retired_transitions: SAFE_AT_T iff retired_known_at(T) with t<=T; anything after T POST_T_FORBIDDEN
risk_table.v35_probabilities: POST_T_FORBIDDEN as decision input (no V3.5 features enter the simulator; C-role reads frozen V3.5 outputs for consistency audit only)

consequences_simulated_not_set: track position after rejoin (emerges from pit loss + frozen mechanics)
future lap times and pace evolution
direct_intervention_variables: forced pit-stop event for target at L_T+1 (PIT_NOW) or L_T+2 (PIT_NEXT_LAP, unless baseline pits first -> SUPERSEDED)
suppression of target baseline pit decision once at L_T+1 (STAY_OUT)
tyre compound for the forced stint (explicit or simulator-sampled)
tyre age reset to 0 on forced stop; target_age otherwise untouched
pit-stop count increment on forced stop
intervention_semantics.principle: Set ONLY the minimal causal intervention variables at the decision point. NEVER manually set downstream outcomes (positions, gaps, times); they must emerge from frozen MC2 mechanics.

mc2_identity.intervention_seam: MonteCarloEngine.run(..., intervention=...) + collect_index_outcomes=True; frozen draw order compound->loss->stint target; intervention=None byte-identical to Phase-6

non_goals: modify Phase 7 / MC2 / V3.5 runtime behavior
frontend features, API contract changes, serving changes, new dependencies
future information at decision time T

classification.DNF_RETIREMENT_OUTCOMES: DERIVABLE (retired entries exist in FinishOrder schema; frozen engine emits no DNFs -> report as not-modeled, never zero-filled)
classification.DOWNSIDE_RISK: DERIVABLE (paired P(worse finish) / P(finish loss >= k); V3.6B freezes k)
classification.EXPECTED_POINTS: REQUIRES_EXTENSION (points not in frozen DriverSimulationSummary; needs audited points table -> V3.6B decision)
classification.MEDIAN_FINISH_AND_QUANTILES: DERIVABLE (paired per-index position diffs; report with MC uncertainty)

phase7_audit_identity.comparison: v1 (DELTA_POLICY complete_valid_pairs; single driver; baseline run once, K candidates paired)
phase7_audit_identity.crn: CRN_ADOPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS (per-(seed,index) streams; shares environment not trajectory)
phase7_audit_identity.engine: frozen Phase-6 MonteCarloEngine r5 + pit dynamics r6 (NOT YET MC2-E kernel; rebase is Strategy 2.0's core delta)
phase7_audit_identity.estimator: paired mean over complete valid pairs (d_win, d_podium, d_finish=base-cand)
phase7_audit_identity.uncertainty: MONTE_CARLO_SAMPLING_UNCERTAINTY_ONLY (paired SE + paired percentile bootstrap B=2000, MIN_VALID_PAIRS_FOR_CI=30)
phase7_audit_identity.wording: no best/recommended/optimal; point-estimate leader with not-a-recommendation disclaimer (FORBIDDEN_STRATEGY_COPY enforced)

primary_outcome_policy.presentation: trade-off vector per alternative (delta win pp, delta podium pp, delta Top5 pp, delta expected finish pos, downside-risk delta), each with paired 95% MC interval + classification; objective-specific point-estimate leader labeled per explicit objective, never ranked as best
primary_outcome_policy.rationale: Reducing strategy to one scalaror synthetic score is scientifically undesirable; no arbitrary utility weights are admitted in V3.6
primary_outcome_policy.synthetic_score: FORBIDDEN (no STRATEGY SCORE; objectives.py precedent: metrics are never combined into a weighted score)

prohibited_fusion: no averaging of V3.5 marginals with MC2 frequencies
no field normalization of V3.5 outputs
no weighted blending / stacking / heuristic score fusion
V3.8 owns Model x Simulation consensus/fusion; V3.6 must not pre-empt it
scientific_question: Given a causal race state at decision time T, how do plausible strategy interventions change the simulated distribution of future race outcomes under paired stochastic futures?

simulation_count_recommendation.adopt: 5000 paired futures per action (baseline + each admitted alternative share one seed family)
simulation_count_recommendation.feasibility_note: S7 measured 10k/3cands ~48.5s sync; 5k/4cands is the heavier-but-bounded default; V3.6F owns async/cache/demo policy
simulation_count_recommendation.rationale: aligns with frozen MC2 production/demo count; V3.2E convergence TV(5k->10k)=0.0046 within gate; CRN variance reduction lowers required N vs unpaired

stage_plan: V3.6B action/state/intervention contract + eligibility (StrategyEligibility + StrategyComparisonKey freeze)
V3.6C paired MC2 strategy engine (thin layer; MC2-E rebase)
V3.6D historical scientific evaluation + stability/coverage (designed in A, executed in D)
V3.6E controlled refinement IF WARRANTED (skipped unless D finds defensible refinement)
temporal_safety: RETROSPECTIVE_PRODUCT execution policy; through-2024 frozen params
no historical future used at decision time

uncertainty_semantics.available: AVAILABLE / INSUFFICIENT_PAIRS(<30, CI withheld, point+SE kept) / NO_VALID_PAIRS
uncertainty_semantics.method: paired SE (std(ddof=1)/sqrt(n)) + paired percentile bootstrap (B=2000, 95%, linear quantile, complete pair as unit); bootstrap seed derived per (substrate,subject,metric), never touches sim RNG
uncertainty_semantics.terminology: MONTE_CARLO_SAMPLING_UNCERTAINTY_ONLY. NEVER 'model uncertainty', NEVER 'real-world confidence interval'. UI label: '95% MC interval'.

unsupported_state_policy: UNSUPPORTED != NEGATIVE RESULT. Return explicit unsupported_reason (200 supported=false) or evaluated=false + static reason per candidate. NEVER fabricate an alternative, fall back to constants, or silently use stale/future data.

v35_identity.probability_semantics: PER_DRIVER_MARGINAL (NOT a joint finishing-order distribution; NOT field-normalized; NOT exact P1-P20 probabilities; NOT MC2 frequencies)

C_VALIDATION_CONSISTENCY_SIGNAL.semantic_compatibility: PASS (both estimate per-driver outcome tendency, compared as diagnostics)
C_VALIDATION_CONSISTENCY_SIGNAL.temporal_safety: PASS (frozen V3.5 outputs read offline; no leakage into simulator)

D_UI_CONTEXT_ONLY.supporting_use: ADMITTED as secondary display context with marginal-not-joint labeling; never a decision input

supporting_uses: D_UI_CONTEXT_ONLY with explicit PER-DRIVER MARGINAL labeling
